note: Year one for this league -- no bidding history yet, so every bid below is stated as unpriced rather than borrowed from the HBGBs' 10-team half-PPR model. 12 teams on 100 FAAB chasing a thinner pool (72 startable RB/WR spots vs the HBGBs' 60) means real bids here will clear higher than HBGBs prices for an equivalent name. Headline change since yesterday: Demarcus Robinson is upgraded to PURSUE off a confirmed Thursday line (2 catches on 3 targets, 50 yards, a 39-yard TD in San Francisco's 27-7 win) -- he's still unrostered here. Drop candidate is Daniel Jones, my own backup QB add from earlier this week -- with Drake Maye healthy and starting, a QB2 is the easiest cut on a full 5-man bench. Cardinals' Week 1 depth chart names Tyler Allgeier (LaPray0814's) RB1 over Jeremiyah Love (my own RB), burying Bam Knight at RB3 with no path -- not a fit for anyone. Malik Davis's season-ending hip surgery hands Dallas' RB3 job to Emari Demercado, but Javonte Williams (tyanserg's bench piece) remains the starter, so there's no fantasy-relevant opportunity there for me. BrittAndTheBoys is the one roster with an acute, visible hole -- A.J. Brown is on IR in their starting WR slot -- worth watching if they come after any WR named below.
